description: ADAPTIVE profile, regime part. Used only for the DATA gates and the VOLATILITY brake (stale or missing candles, one 0.8% bar or 0.15% stdev of 5-minute moves): the strategy comes from the selector, which reads the market itself. 6 candles (30 minutes) before anything is classified, so the first possible decision is 09:45. Still OUR choices, NOT validated on real market data.
